summary: Validated new features: supplier field + PDF export per supplier + goods transfer between locations. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass (12 new tests across TestSupplier/TestSuppliersEndpoint/TestTransfer plus all previous regressions). Frontend: all target flows work on the mobile web preview at 390×844.

backend_coverage.supplier_field: POST /api/products accepts supplier and persists it; PATCH updates it; empty / whitespace-only supplier becomes null on read (verified via GET round-trip).
backend_coverage.suppliers_endpoint: GET /api/suppliers?stock_id returns distinct non-empty suppliers of ONLY that stock, sorted case-insensitively; empty/whitespace excluded; missing stock_id returns 400/422; cross-stock supplier does not leak.
backend_coverage.transfer: POST /api/products/{id}/transfer: happy path moves qty and keeps total unchanged; adds destination row when product didn't have it; 400 on quantity<=0, 400 on from==to, 400 when quantity > available; 404 when source not on product; 404 when destination is neither on product nor a managed location of the stock.

frontend_coverage.reorder_footer: share-list-btn and order-pdf-btn both render in reorder tab footer. order-pdf-btn navigates to /order-export.
frontend_coverage.order_export_page: sections rendered in correct order: Alfa Spa, Zeta Srl, Senza fornitore (last). suggestedQty prefill correct: p1 total=3 min=10 => 17; p2 total=1 min=8 => 15; p3 total=0 min=5 => 10. Steppers editable (minus clamps at 0). Export for 'Senza fornitore' with all qty=0 produced order-toast 'Nessuna quantità da ordinare per questo fornitore'. Export for 'Alfa Spa' triggered window.print on web with no error toast.
frontend_coverage.product_detail_transfer: supplier-input shows persisted 'Zeta Srl' for p1 (A=1, B=2). open-transfer-btn opens sheet. transfer-from-A and transfer-from-B both visible (only sources with qty>0); transfer-to-B visible, transfer-to-A hidden until a different 'from' is chosen (correct: destinations exclude current 'from'). transfer-qty-plus clamps at available (clicked 5× with B->A, qty stays at 2). transfer-confirm succeeds; form-total still shows '3 pz' (total unchanged after transfer).
frontend_coverage.supplier_chips_new_product: On /product/new, supplier-input renders plus chips supplier-chip-'Alfa Spa' and supplier-chip-'Zeta Srl' (sourced from the live /api/suppliers). Tapping a chip fills the input ('Alfa Spa').

critical_code_review_comments: exportOrderPdf (order-pdf.ts): the web branch uses window.print() via expo-print – on mobile Safari / inside an iframe, the print dialog can be silently blocked. Not an issue in the preview, but worth confirming before shipping.
/api/suppliers performs case-sensitive dedup ('Alfa'/'alfa' both returned). Consider case-insensitive dedup for cleaner supplier chips if desired – current behaviour meets the spec.

TransferModal.destinations list is built from stockLocations and excludes current 'from' only. Good UX, but a product can't have its qty copied to a destination that doesn't yet exist on the product AND isn't a managed location – server returns 404 which is correctly surfaced via the transfer-error label.
No pagination on /api/suppliers but the response is a plain string list, acceptable for the data scale.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_stockcount_api.py (added 12 tests: TestSupplier x3, TestSuppliersEndpoint x2, TestTransfer x7)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of specified flows (supplier form + chips, transfer sheet with clamp + confirm + total-unchanged, reorder footer buttons, /order-export grouping + suggested qty + zero-qty toast + Alfa PDF without crash)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_SUP_fb0d stock with locations A/B and three products (Zeta Srl A=1 B=2 min=10; Alfa Spa A=1 min=8; no supplier A=0 min=5). Deleted at the end (verified: stocks list = ['Negozio','Casa','Materiale elettronico']). Backend tests use TEST_LOC_*/TEST_Stock_*/TEST_SupScope_* ephemeral stocks that each clean up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reorder tab path is /reorder (not /(tabs)/reorder). Supplier endpoint keeps case-sensitive distinct. Transfer modal 'destinations' chips exclude the chosen 'from' chip, so when switching 'from' the previously selected 'to' is cleared if it collides. QuantityStepper -value cell can read null via document.querySelector in some re-renders; prefer reading via /api round-trip or form-total text to assert state. Direct outbound HTTP from browser-automation (urllib) is blocked (403); use a separate bash step to seed and pass IDs into the script.
